resources.string: Neesherura ebyagambirwe omu maraka na vidiyo omu %1$s, ebi okusherura kw\'Orungyereza kutarikubaasa kushoma. Omu kukyebera kwaitu eiraka erihikire ryaija ery\'okubanza %2$d%%, aha %3$d%% kutarimu.

Neeshoma obwakabiri ebigambo ebitari by\'Orungyereza, n\'ahabw\'ekyo fayiro ezo zitwara obwire bwingi kushoma, kandi terikuhikaana gye: teekateeka ebigambo ebimwe ebihabire. Orungyereza rushomwa nk\'oku rwaabaire. Orurimi rumwe aha murundi gumwe; rwetaaga obwongo obw\'okwongyeraho obu rurikukora bwonka.
